headline: Chile GDP Contracts 1.1% in Third Quarter on Mining Slump
summary: Chile's economy shrank 1.1% in the third quarter of 2026, driven down by a 17.7% contraction in mining activity.
why: Chile is the world's leading producer of copper and a key exporter of lithium.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: A steep drop in mining output dragged overall GDP into contraction.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A sharp decline in copper mining output produced an unexpected quarterly economic shrinkage.
